scientific_integrity: Exact universal proof via two Hensel roots and a two-centre dyadic valuation lemma; integer arithmetic checks supplement but do not replace proof.
scientific_limitations: Coefficients restricted to positive odd a,b and positive even c; no claim for other parity types or polynomial pairs; possible uncatalogued equivalents in dyadic valuation correlation literature; independent validation not performed.
title: Exact dyadic neighbour-valuation laws and a resultant-controlled covariance reversal for quadratic sequences
